title: Block Randomizer
description: Block Randomizer Challenge is Now Online and Ready to Play
body:
Randomizer Mod changes Minecraft by giving every block a unique random item drop.
When a block is broken for the first time, it receives a random item from the entire item list.
From that point on, that block type will always drop the same assigned item for the rest of the world.

This creates a simple but fun challenge that works well for survival runs, SMP events, or randomizer gameplay.

How it works
Each block type gets one random item the first time it is broken

The assigned drop stays the same for the entire session

Vanilla drops are replaced

Only one item is dropped per block

Commands
/challenge start – Enables the randomizer

/challenge pause – Pauses the randomizer

/challenge stop – Disables the randomizer

![Commands](https://github.com/LeLe-YT/LZS-Lizenz/blob/main/ModBild1.png)

Features
Consistent random drops

Works in singleplayer and multiplayer

Sound feedback for each command

Lightweight and easy to use
